SELECT b.book_id, b.book_cover, b.book_title, b.book_author, g.genre_name, b.book_publisher, b.book_price FROM books b INNER JOIN genres g ON b.book_genre = g.genre_id WHERE b.book_flag = TRUE
ORDER BY b.book_id ASC
ORDER BY b.book_price ASC, b.book_id ASC
ORDER BY b.book_price DESC, b.book_id DESC
ORDER BY b.book_id DESC
LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
